Overview

San Miguel is a city in SM with a population of 250,000. A vibrant eastern city known for its Carnival celebrations and commercial activity in the Pacific lowlands. Housing costs are close to the national average. The overall cost of living is below the national average. Gardening thrives here — the 7b growing zone supports Mild — wide variety of vegetables, many fruit trees. A relatively small share of residents hold a bachelor’s degree. The population skews young, with a median age of 28.0.
